blocks.source: Canto XVII
blocks.translation: Canto XVII

blocks.source: «Ecco la fiera con la coda aguzza,
blocks.translation: “Behold the monster with the pointed tail,

blocks.source: che passa i monti e rompe i muri e l’armi!
blocks.translation: Who cleaves the hills, and breaketh walls and weapons,

blocks.source: Ecco colei che tutto ’l mondo appuzza!».
blocks.translation: Behold him who infecteth all the world.”

blocks.source: Sì cominciò lo mio duca a parlarmi;
blocks.translation: Thus unto me my Guide began to say,

blocks.source: e accennolle che venisse a proda,
blocks.translation: And beckoned him that he should come to shore,

blocks.source: vicino al fin d’i passeggiati marmi.
blocks.translation: Near to the confine of the trodden marble;

blocks.source: E quella sozza imagine di froda
blocks.translation: And that uncleanly image of deceit

blocks.source: sen venne, e arrivò la testa e ’l busto,
blocks.translation: Came up and thrust ashore its head and bust,

blocks.source: ma ’n su la riva non trasse la coda.
blocks.translation: But on the border did not drag its tail.

blocks.source: La faccia sua era faccia d’uom giusto,
blocks.translation: The face was as the face of a just man,

blocks.source: tanto benigna avea di fuor la pelle,
blocks.translation: Its semblance outwardly was so benign,

blocks.source: e d’un serpente tutto l’altro fusto;
blocks.translation: And of a serpent all the trunk beside.

blocks.source: due branche avea pilose insin l’ascelle;
blocks.translation: Two paws it had, hairy unto the armpits;

blocks.source: lo dosso e ’l petto e ambedue le coste
blocks.translation: The back, and breast, and both the sides it had

blocks.source: dipinti avea di nodi e di rotelle.
blocks.translation: Depicted o’er with nooses and with shields.

blocks.source: Con più color, sommesse e sovraposte
blocks.translation: With colours more, groundwork or broidery

blocks.source: non fer mai drappi Tartari né Turchi,
blocks.translation: Never in cloth did Tartars make nor Turks,

blocks.source: né fuor tai tele per Aragne imposte.
blocks.translation: Nor were such tissues by Arachne laid.

blocks.source: Come talvolta stanno a riva i burchi,
blocks.translation: As sometimes wherries lie upon the shore,

blocks.source: che parte sono in acqua e parte in terra,
blocks.translation: That part are in the water, part on land;

blocks.source: e come là tra li Tedeschi lurchi
blocks.translation: And as among the guzzling Germans there,

blocks.source: lo bivero s’assetta a far sua guerra,
blocks.translation: The beaver plants himself to wage his war;

blocks.source: così la fiera pessima si stava
blocks.translation: So that vile monster lay upon the border,

blocks.source: su l’orlo ch’è di pietra e ’l sabbion serra.
blocks.translation: Which is of stone, and shutteth in the sand.

blocks.source: Nel vano tutta sua coda guizzava,
blocks.translation: His tail was wholly quivering in the void,

blocks.source: torcendo in sù la venenosa forca
blocks.translation: Contorting upwards the envenomed fork,

blocks.source: ch’a guisa di scorpion la punta armava.
blocks.translation: That in the guise of scorpion armed its point.

blocks.source: Lo duca disse: «Or convien che si torca
blocks.translation: The Guide said: “Now perforce must turn aside

blocks.source: la nostra via un poco insino a quella
blocks.translation: Our way a little, even to that beast

blocks.source: bestia malvagia che colà si corca».
blocks.translation: Malevolent, that yonder coucheth him.”

blocks.source: Però scendemmo a la destra mammella,
blocks.translation: We therefore on the right side descended,

blocks.source: e diece passi femmo in su lo stremo,
blocks.translation: And made ten steps upon the outer verge,

blocks.source: per ben cessar la rena e la fiammella.
blocks.translation: Completely to avoid the sand and flame;

blocks.source: E quando noi a lei venuti semo,
blocks.translation: And after we are come to him, I see

blocks.source: poco più oltre veggio in su la rena
blocks.translation: A little farther off upon the sand

blocks.source: gente seder propinqua al loco scemo.
blocks.translation: A people sitting near the hollow place.

blocks.source: Quivi ’l maestro «Acciò che tutta piena
blocks.translation: Then said to me the Master: “So that full

blocks.source: esperïenza d’esto giron porti»,
blocks.translation: Experience of this round thou bear away,

blocks.source: mi disse, «va, e vedi la lor mena.
blocks.translation: Now go and see what their condition is.

blocks.source: Li tuoi ragionamenti sian là corti;
blocks.translation: There let thy conversation be concise;

blocks.source: mentre che torni, parlerò con questa,
blocks.translation: Till thou returnest I will speak with him,

blocks.source: che ne conceda i suoi omeri forti».
blocks.translation: That he concede to us his stalwart shoulders.”

blocks.source: Così ancor su per la strema testa
blocks.translation: Thus farther still upon the outermost

blocks.source: di quel settimo cerchio tutto solo
blocks.translation: Head of that seventh circle all alone

blocks.source: andai, dove sedea la gente mesta.
blocks.translation: I went, where sat the melancholy folk.

blocks.source: Per li occhi fora scoppiava lor duolo;
blocks.translation: Out of their eyes was gushing forth their woe;

blocks.source: di qua, di là soccorrien con le mani
blocks.translation: This way, that way, they helped them with their hands

blocks.source: quando a’ vapori, e quando al caldo suolo:
blocks.translation: Now from the flames and now from the hot soil.

blocks.source: non altrimenti fan di state i cani
blocks.translation: Not otherwise in summer do the dogs,

blocks.source: or col ceffo or col piè, quando son morsi
blocks.translation: Now with the foot, now with the muzzle, when

blocks.source: o da pulci o da mosche o da tafani.
blocks.translation: By fleas, or flies, or gadflies, they are bitten.

blocks.source: Poi che nel viso a certi li occhi porsi,
blocks.translation: When I had turned mine eyes upon the faces

blocks.source: ne’ quali ’l doloroso foco casca,
blocks.translation: Of some, on whom the dolorous fire is falling,

blocks.source: non ne conobbi alcun; ma io m’accorsi
blocks.translation: Not one of them I knew; but I perceived

blocks.source: che dal collo a ciascun pendea una tasca
blocks.translation: That from the neck of each there hung a pouch,

blocks.source: ch’avea certo colore e certo segno,
blocks.translation: Which certain colour had, and certain blazon;

blocks.source: e quindi par che ’l loro occhio si pasca.
blocks.translation: And thereupon it seems their eyes are feeding.

blocks.source: E com’ io riguardando tra lor vegno,
blocks.translation: And as I gazing round me come among them,

blocks.source: in una borsa gialla vidi azzurro
blocks.translation: Upon a yellow pouch I azure saw

blocks.source: che d’un leone avea faccia e contegno.
blocks.translation: That had the face and posture of a lion.

blocks.source: Poi, procedendo di mio sguardo il curro,
blocks.translation: Proceeding then the current of my sight,

blocks.source: vidine un’altra come sangue rossa,
blocks.translation: Another of them saw I, red as blood,

blocks.source: mostrando un’oca bianca più che burro.
blocks.translation: Display a goose more white than butter is.

blocks.source: E un che d’una scrofa azzurra e grossa
blocks.translation: And one, who with an azure sow and gravid

blocks.source: segnato avea lo suo sacchetto bianco,
blocks.translation: Emblazoned had his little pouch of white,

blocks.source: mi disse: «Che fai tu in questa fossa?
blocks.translation: Said unto me: “What dost thou in this moat?

blocks.source: Or te ne va; e perché se’ vivo anco,
blocks.translation: Now get thee gone; and since thou’rt still alive,

blocks.source: sappi che ’l mio vicin Vitalïano
blocks.translation: Know that a neighbour of mine, Vitaliano,

blocks.source: sederà qui dal mio sinistro fianco.
blocks.translation: Will have his seat here on my left-hand side.

blocks.source: Con questi Fiorentin son padoano:
blocks.translation: A Paduan am I with these Florentines;

blocks.source: spesse fïate mi ’ntronan li orecchi
blocks.translation: Full many a time they thunder in mine ears,

blocks.source: gridando: “Vegna ’l cavalier sovrano,
blocks.translation: Exclaiming, ‘Come the sovereign cavalier,

blocks.source: che recherà la tasca con tre becchi!”».
blocks.translation: He who shall bring the satchel with three goats;’”

blocks.source: Qui distorse la bocca e di fuor trasse
blocks.translation: Then twisted he his mouth, and forth he thrust

blocks.source: la lingua, come bue che ’l naso lecchi.
blocks.translation: His tongue, like to an ox that licks its nose.

blocks.source: E io, temendo no ’l più star crucciasse
blocks.translation: And fearing lest my longer stay might vex

blocks.source: lui che di poco star m’avea ’mmonito,
blocks.translation: Him who had warned me not to tarry long,

blocks.source: torna’mi in dietro da l’anime lasse.
blocks.translation: Backward I turned me from those weary souls.

blocks.source: Trova’ il duca mio ch’era salito
blocks.translation: I found my Guide, who had already mounted

blocks.source: già su la groppa del fiero animale,
blocks.translation: Upon the back of that wild animal,

blocks.source: e disse a me: «Or sie forte e ardito.
blocks.translation: And said to me: “Now be both strong and bold.

blocks.source: Omai si scende per sì fatte scale;
blocks.translation: Now we descend by stairways such as these;

blocks.source: monta dinanzi, ch’i’ voglio esser mezzo,
blocks.translation: Mount thou in front, for I will be midway,

blocks.source: sì che la coda non possa far male».
blocks.translation: So that the tail may have no power to harm thee.”

blocks.source: Qual è colui che sì presso ha ’l riprezzo
blocks.translation: Such as he is who has so near the ague

blocks.source: de la quartana, c’ha già l’unghie smorte,
blocks.translation: Of quartan that his nails are blue already,

blocks.source: e triema tutto pur guardando ’l rezzo,
blocks.translation: And trembles all, but looking at the shade;

blocks.source: tal divenn’ io a le parole porte;
blocks.translation: Even such became I at those proffered words;

blocks.source: ma vergogna mi fé le sue minacce,
blocks.translation: But shame in me his menaces produced,

blocks.source: che innanzi a buon segnor fa servo forte.
blocks.translation: Which maketh servant strong before good master.

blocks.source: I’ m’assettai in su quelle spallacce;
blocks.translation: I seated me upon those monstrous shoulders;

blocks.source: sì volli dir, ma la voce non venne
blocks.translation: I wished to say, and yet the voice came not

blocks.source: com’ io credetti: ‘Fa che tu m’abbracce’.
blocks.translation: As I believed, “Take heed that thou embrace me.”

blocks.source: Ma esso, ch’altra volta mi sovvenne
blocks.translation: But he, who other times had rescued me

blocks.source: ad altro forse, tosto ch’i’ montai
blocks.translation: In other peril, soon as I had mounted,

blocks.source: con le braccia m’avvinse e mi sostenne;
blocks.translation: Within his arms encircled and sustained me,

blocks.source: e disse: «Gerïon, moviti omai:
blocks.translation: And said: “Now, Geryon, bestir thyself;

blocks.source: le rote larghe, e lo scender sia poco;
blocks.translation: The circles large, and the descent be little;

blocks.source: pensa la nova soma che tu hai».
blocks.translation: Think of the novel burden which thou hast.”

blocks.source: Come la navicella esce di loco
blocks.translation: Even as the little vessel shoves from shore,

blocks.source: in dietro in dietro, sì quindi si tolse;
blocks.translation: Backward, still backward, so he thence withdrew;

blocks.source: e poi ch’al tutto si sentì a gioco,
blocks.translation: And when he wholly felt himself afloat,

blocks.source: là ’v’ era ’l petto, la coda rivolse,
blocks.translation: There where his breast had been he turned his tail,

blocks.source: e quella tesa, come anguilla, mosse,
blocks.translation: And that extended like an eel he moved,

blocks.source: e con le branche l’aere a sé raccolse.
blocks.translation: And with his paws drew to himself the air.

blocks.source: Maggior paura non credo che fosse
blocks.translation: A greater fear I do not think there was

blocks.source: quando Fetonte abbandonò li freni,
blocks.translation: What time abandoned Phaeton the reins,

blocks.source: per che ’l ciel, come pare ancor, si cosse;
blocks.translation: Whereby the heavens, as still appears, were scorched;

blocks.source: né quando Icaro misero le reni
blocks.translation: Nor when the wretched Icarus his flanks

blocks.source: sentì spennar per la scaldata cera,
blocks.translation: Felt stripped of feathers by the melting wax,

blocks.source: gridando il padre a lui «Mala via tieni!»,
blocks.translation: His father crying, “An ill way thou takest!”

blocks.source: che fu la mia, quando vidi ch’i’ era
blocks.translation: Than was my own, when I perceived myself

blocks.source: ne l’aere d’ogne parte, e vidi spenta
blocks.translation: On all sides in the air, and saw extinguished

blocks.source: ogne veduta fuor che de la fera.
blocks.translation: The sight of everything but of the monster.

blocks.source: Ella sen va notando lenta lenta;
blocks.translation: Onward he goeth, swimming slowly, slowly;

blocks.source: rota e discende, ma non me n’accorgo
blocks.translation: Wheels and descends, but I perceive it only

blocks.source: se non che al viso e di sotto mi venta.
blocks.translation: By wind upon my face and from below.

blocks.source: Io sentia già da la man destra il gorgo
blocks.translation: I heard already on the right the whirlpool

blocks.source: far sotto noi un orribile scroscio,
blocks.translation: Making a horrible crashing under us;

blocks.source: per che con li occhi ’n giù la testa sporgo.
blocks.translation: Whence I thrust out my head with eyes cast downward.

blocks.source: Allor fu’ io più timido a lo stoscio,
blocks.translation: Then was I still more fearful of the abyss;

blocks.source: però ch’i’ vidi fuochi e senti’ pianti;
blocks.translation: Because I fires beheld, and heard laments,

blocks.source: ond’ io tremando tutto mi raccoscio.
blocks.translation: Whereat I, trembling, all the closer cling.

blocks.source: E vidi poi, ché nol vedea davanti,
blocks.translation: I saw then, for before I had not seen it,

blocks.source: lo scendere e ’l girar per li gran mali
blocks.translation: The turning and descending, by great horrors

blocks.source: che s’appressavan da diversi canti.
blocks.translation: That were approaching upon divers sides.

blocks.source: Come ’l falcon ch’è stato assai su l’ali,
blocks.translation: As falcon who has long been on the wing,

blocks.source: che sanza veder logoro o uccello
blocks.translation: Who, without seeing either lure or bird,

blocks.source: fa dire al falconiere «Omè, tu cali!»,
blocks.translation: Maketh the falconer say, “Ah me, thou stoopest,”

blocks.source: discende lasso onde si move isnello,
blocks.translation: Descendeth weary, whence he started swiftly,

blocks.source: per cento rote, e da lunge si pone
blocks.translation: Thorough a hundred circles, and alights

blocks.source: dal suo maestro, disdegnoso e fello;
blocks.translation: Far from his master, sullen and disdainful;

blocks.source: così ne puose al fondo Gerïone
blocks.translation: Even thus did Geryon place us on the bottom,

blocks.source: al piè al piè de la stagliata rocca,
blocks.translation: Close to the bases of the rough-hewn rock,

blocks.source: e, discarcate le nostre persone,
blocks.translation: And being disencumbered of our persons,

blocks.source: si dileguò come da corda cocca.
blocks.translation: He sped away as arrow from the string.
